name: MonarchPostCard
title: PostCard
wrapsNative: MonarchCard holding a Button (author line in MonarchFlowLayout with MonarchAvatar and MonarchBadge, title, excerpt) and an HStack footer; TimelineView(.everyMinute) for the relative time
summary: A post in a community feed or search result: author, relative time, pinned and answered markers, tags, title, a short excerpt, and reaction and comment counts.
whenToUse: In a community feed, a forum list or search results, where each post opens its own screen.
whenNotToUse: Not for a chat message; use the conversation's message bubble. Not for a link preview; use MonarchLinkCard.
api: init(_ title: String, author: String, authorAvatarURL: URL? = nil, excerpt: String? = nil, excerptLength: Int = 220, publishedAt: Date? = nil, now: Date? = nil, tags: [MonarchPostCardTag] = [], isPinned: Bool = false, isAnswered: Bool = false, reactionCount: Int? = nil, commentCount: Int? = nil, labels: MonarchPostCardLabels = MonarchPostCardLabels(), action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(_ title: String, author: String, authorAvatarURL: URL? = nil, excerpt: String? = nil, excerptLength: Int = 220, publishedAt: Date? = nil, now: Date? = nil, tags: [MonarchPostCardTag] = [], isPinned: Bool = false, isAnswered: Bool = false, reactionCount: Int? = nil, commentCount: Int? = nil, labels: MonarchPostCardLabels = MonarchPostCardLabels(), action: @escaping @MainActor () -> Void) where Actions == EmptyView
MonarchPostCardLabels.init(pinned: String? = nil, answered: String? = nil, reactions: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil, comments: (@Sendable (Int) -> String)? = nil)

options.name: author
options.description: Who wrote it; also the avatar's initials.

options.name: authorAvatarURL
options.description: The author's picture, loaded with AsyncImage.

options.name: excerpt
options.description: Plain text of the post. Strip formatting before passing it.

options.name: excerptLength
options.description: The longest excerpt in characters; longer text is cut at a word boundary with an ellipsis.

options.name: publishedAt
options.description: When it was published, shown relative to now, such as "3 hours ago".

options.name: now
options.description: Fixes now for the relative time. Without it the time follows the clock and updates every minute.

options.name: tags
options.description: Markers after the time, as subtle badges in their tones.

options.name: isAnswered
options.description: Shows a success badge "Answered" with a check mark.

options.name: reactionCount
options.description: The number of reactions; hidden when nil.

options.name: commentCount
options.description: The number of comments; hidden when nil.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Pinned", "Answered" and the spoken counts.

options.name: actions
options.description: Controls at the end of the footer, such as a bookmark toggle. Each is its own button.

states.name: default
states.description: Author line, title, and the excerpt and counts when given.

states.name: pinned
states.description: A pin glyph and "Pinned" in the author line.

states.name: answered
states.description: A success badge with a check mark and "Answered".

states.name: pressed
states.description: The system's plain button press feedback on the author line, title and excerpt.

appearance: A MonarchCard on the surface colour with its border and shadow; the title in the default text colour, the author line, excerpt and counts in the muted text colour, and badges in their tones' subtle colours. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web card is an article whose title is a link with an href and an optional renderLink; on iOS the author line, title and excerpt are one button that runs action, so the app navigates with its own NavigationStack. The heading level option has no meaning on iOS. The time uses RelativeDateTimeFormatter in the view's locale instead of the web's RelativeTime component. Footer actions are separate buttons, never nested in the card's button.
accessibility: The author line, title and excerpt are one button that reads them in order: author, time, markers, title, excerpt.
The counts are one element read as "12 reactions, 4 comments".
The avatar and the icons are hidden from VoiceOver.
The answered state is a badge with text and a check mark, and pinned is a glyph with text, so neither depends on colour.
Footer actions keep their own names and traits.
All text wraps and scales with Dynamic Type.
edgeCases: An excerpt that is empty after trimming is not shown.
A single word longer than the cut is cut at the limit.
Counts of zero are shown; pass nil to hide a count.
Large counts use the locale's grouping, such as 1,204.
Many tags wrap onto new lines.

examples.title: Post
examples.code:
MonarchPostCard(
    "How do you plan your week?",
    author: "Sam Lee",
    excerpt: "I keep a short list every Monday and review it on Friday. Curious what works for others, especially with a lot of meetings.",
    publishedAt: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_778_403_600),
    now: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_778_414_400),
    tags: [MonarchPostCardTag("Questions"), MonarchPostCardTag("Planning")],
    isAnswered: true,
    reactionCount: 12,
    commentCount: 8
) {
    opened = true
}
